themeBadNameInvalid: `{name}` is not a valid theme name
themeBadNameInvalidFix: use unaccented lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to {max} characters, e.g. `my-theme`
themeBadNameBuiltin: `{name}` is the name of a built-in theme
themeBadColourAlpha: `{value}` has alpha and `{key}` is painted over the page
themeDuplicateKeyDarkTableFix: keep a single `[dark]` table at the end of the file
themeSyntaxLineFix: each line is `key = "#rrggbb"`, a `#` comment or `[dark]`
themeSyntaxTrailingFix: keep only `key = "#rrggbb"` and, if you like, a `#` comment
themeUnknownKeyFix: remove it; the valid keys are in {example}
themeUnknownKeyFixSuggest: did you mean `{suggestion}`? The valid keys are in {example}
themeReadFailedNotAFile: not a theme file (a link, a folder or too large)
themeReadFailedNotAFileFix: use a regular .toml file of a few hundred bytes
themeReadFailedWriteFix: check the permissions of the themes folder
themeLinkedDir: the themes folder is a link and harbard does not follow it
themeLinkedDirFix: use a regular folder at that path; to sync, copy the .toml files or share the code
themeMissingThemeFix: see the names with `harbard theme list`
themeMissingThemeFixCase: the file is `{file}`: rename it to `{wanted}`
themeBadCodeCount: it has {count} colours and a v1 code carries {expected}
themeBadCodeAlpha: `{value}` has alpha and `{key}` is painted over the page (position {position})
themeBadCodeFix: copy the whole code with "Copy code to share"; it starts with harbard-theme:v1:
themeExistsFix: choose another name or overwrite it (`--force` in the CLI)
themeLowContrastLight: insufficient contrast in light mode: {section}`{fg}` on `{on}` ({what}) gives {ratio}:1 and needs {min}:1
themeLowContrastDark: insufficient contrast in dark mode: {section}`{fg}` on `{on}` ({what}) gives {ratio}:1 and needs {min}:1
themeLowContrastFixFg: change `{fg}` so it reads over `{on}`, or remove it and harbard derives it
themeLowContrastFixBg: change `{first_bg}` (or `{fg}`), or remove it and harbard derives it
themeNoticeBadMode: The saved mode "{mode}" does not exist; using Light.
themeNoticeRefused: The theme "{theme}" cannot be applied ({why}); using the default theme.
themeNoticeAbsent: The theme "{theme}" cannot be applied (not in the themes folder); using the default theme.
retroEvidenceSharedSecurity: {items}. The same piece was written on each branch.
retroEvidenceStalls: {stall} waiting for a permission, the longest {longest} min ({dates}).
retroEvidencePlainMessages: {unclear} marked "I don't understand", {asked} asking what something means, {jargon} with jargon.
retroEvidenceReadableNames: {down} with 👎, {renamed} and {generated} with numbers, suffixes or no name.
retroEvidenceBackgroundWaitOne: 1 agent ended its turn waiting for a background task.
retroEvidenceBackgroundWaitMany: {count} agents ended their turn waiting for a background task.
retroEvidenceDeliveryQuality: {delivery} that didn't help or were missing something.
